comments.author: Michael Ferrando
comments.html:
Question – Why did Audible pull the Audio version of the new book?

Thanks.

Mike

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: Hi Mike. I found an editing error in my Author’s early copy and so my publisher is having Brilliance audio fix it. The delay shouldn’t be long.

replies.author: Michael Ferrando
replies.html: Thanks. Look forward to it. New narrator. Hope he does a good job.

comments.author: Richard Phillips
comments.html: Yes. MacLeod Andrews wasn’t available for this time frame but I think Alexander Cendese does a good job with it.

replies.author: Peter
replies.html: Hi Richard. Alexander Cendese did an okay job, but MacLeod Andrews was wonderful. All 6 books he did an admirable job, especially Jack. I hope MacLeod will be available for your next audio book. I would like MacLeod’s take on voicing the Koranthian general.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html: I always request MacLeod, but he’s also a film actor so his schedule depends on what projects he has going on.
